purpose: Which iOS UI cases run in the PR and main gate (#4432 stage 3). ios-ui-shards.py plan --set gate plans exactly these; --set nightly plans every other declared case, and the nightly workflow runs them. No case is deleted. A gate case that is no longer declared is refused.
source: D2 core set (11-24): the 12 gate cases minus the system browser sign-in case, which moved to the nightly set.
separate_jobs: The real Korean voice case runs in the gate's iOS UI real voice job (plan --dedicated). The approval push case runs in the approval push simulator job; in a UI shard it skips itself.
